column1: # Auto-QA coverage map: which auto-QA checks prove a change to which file.
# Read by tools/ops/autoqa-proof and pinned by AutoQaProofMapTest. Three columns, TAB separated:
#   check_id  an id from AutoQaCatalog ("t-mx-1"), or "all" for runner/platform files that every check needs
#   key       a path glob relative to the repo root, or -D<property>=<value> for a switch a check needs,
#             or "-" for a check no file triggers (a person proves it on a real client: see the note)
#             glob: "**" crosses directories, "*" does not, "?" is one character
#   note      why this file belongs to those checks (informal, shown by the tool)
# Rule when adding a check: fill in its scenario file and the feature package it proves.
# Rule when moving a package: fix the globs here; AutoQaProofMapTest fails if a glob matches no tracked file.
